preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of corridors m must be between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, _ in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for _, _, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each corridor must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
